name: 82001 · Cheyenne, WY
findings: ZIP 82001 (Cheyenne) has 283 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 86 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82001 (Cheyenne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 82001 (Cheyenne) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
